title: Out-of-interval vanishing for integral scalar residue layer
statement: The residue-layer tensor homology vanishes outside the source cohomological interval.

source.place: Lemma lemma-tensor-product-locally-constant; lemma-constructible-serre; parent residue-layer argument.

proof.text: Compute source residue reduction using the K-flat counit and localization homology comparison. The source support hypothesis implies that this ordinary residue complex has zero homology outside the interval.

The coefficient-layer isomorphism and the commuting residue triangle identify the layer tensor complex with exact finite-field scalar extension of the source residue complex, followed by scalar restriction.

Exact finite-field scalar extension and exact restriction commute with homology and preserve zero objects. Transport the resulting vanishing through the complex isomorphism. Constructibility and r≤s are not needed for this vanishing clause. Exactness is proved directly via constant-module encoding and flat extension followed by sheafification; the full finite-field scalar-extension module would create an import cycle.

proof_origin.description: F5: explicit K-flat reduction, balanced coefficient-layer comparison, and exact-functor homology transport.

theorem integralScalarResidueLayer_vanishing
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{d}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory)
    (r s : ℤ) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (h₁ : intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible l E 1 (by omega) Y
      ((integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl 0).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)))
    (hbound : ∀ i : ℤ,
      i ∈ proEtaleCohomologicalSupport
        ((integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl 0).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)) →
      r ≤ i ∧ i ≤ s) (n : ℕ)
    (F : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → Submodule
      (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (n + 1)))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (n + 1))))
    (hF : F = fun (j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) ↦ (Ideal.span ({ULift.up ((Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionIdeal l L (n + 1)))
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l L))} :
          Set (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (n + 1))))) ^ ((j : ℕ))) :
    letI := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing l L (n + 1) (by omega)
    let B := ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (n + 1))
    ∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)) (i : ℤ),
      ((i < r ∨ s < i) → IsZero
        ((filteredCoefficientTensorComplex Y B
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E Y)
          (integralScalarRho l E L ι Y n) P.obj
          (ModuleCat.of B ((F j.castSucc) ⧸
            (F j.succ).comap (F j.castSucc).subtype))).homology i))
